sloka: ऐश्वर्यम् वानराणाम् च दुर्लभम् वालि पालितम् ।अस्या निमित्ते सुग्रीवः प्राप्तवान् लोक सत्कृतम् ॥५-१६-११॥
transliteration: aiśvaryam vānarāṇām ca durlabham vāli pālitam ।asyā nimitte sugrīvaḥ prāptavān loka satkṛtam ॥5-16-11॥

translations.english: On her account Sugriva obtained the coveted kingdom ruled by Vali which was a difficult proposition, and retained supremacy in the world.
